body.name: Admissible probability-floor reshaping domain
body.construction:
For an enumeration \(\mathcal S=(s_1,\ldots,s_k)\), define
\[
 \Delta_{\epsilon}(\mathcal S)
 :=\left\{q=(q_1,\ldots,q_k)\in\mathbb R^k:
          \sum_{a=1}^k q_a=1,\quad q_a\geq\epsilon
          \text{ for every }a\right\}.
\]
